Tightness term: n/a (no lensing/convergence analog in this domain)
Main support: None material: no proxy (choke or baseline) explains >3% of variance in the primary target fA.
Main contradiction: choke_F1 (feed/smoothing alone) shows ~zero correlation with fA (r=-0.03).
Main caveat: n=137 after quality cuts; secondary target Mline shares Mass with the mass_only baseline by construction (not reported as headline).

Dataset: Tempel et al. 2014 SDSS Bisous filaments (MNRAS 438,3465)
Smoothing term: Len (geometric-only; no thermodynamic WHIM data found)
Tightness term: n/a (no lensing/convergence analog in this domain)
Main support: None on the construction-independent target: all R2 < 0.01 for every proxy and baseline.
Main contradiction: The naive concentration_Ng target correlates strongly with choke_F2 (r=0.77), but that correlation is r=0.96 explained by a pure algebraic artifact of shared terms (verified analytically and numerically) -- not physical signal.
Main caveat: No per-filament WHIM temperature/pressure catalog was available (searched, not found in machine-readable per-object form); this sub-analysis is structural/geometric only, not thermodynamic.

Dataset: Anderson et al. 2014 WISE HII regions (ApJS 212,1)
Smoothing term: n/a (uses same ambient model as resistance)
Main support: Ambient resistance carries real, independent information: negative partial correlation with radius holds in all 3 driving terciles (r=-0.44,-0.27,-0.34, all p<1e-4) -- consistent with bubble-specific push-back.
Main contradiction: Driving-only baseline is weak and wrong-signed (R2=0.008, r=-0.09); the multiplicative choke ratio underperforms the plain ambient-only baseline (R2 0.069-0.098 vs 0.111) and a 2-term additive model (R2=0.122) beats the ratio too.
Main caveat: No per-region ionizing-photon luminosity available; DV is a kinematic, not photometric, driving proxy. Local Bubble/heliosphere pilot (n=4) logged separately, not statistically tested.

Dataset: redMaPPer SDSS DR8 x Sereno & Ettori 2017 WL-mass forecast (ApJS 224,1 / MNRAS 468,3322)
Best-performing choke proxy: regression: lambda+z+neighbor R2=0.9748; classification: lambda*MWLc AUC=0.700
Baseline comparator: regression: lambda+z R2=0.9728; classification: lambda-only AUC=0.618
Did choke proxy outperform baseline?: Regression: negligible (dR2=0.0020, statistically significant only because N=26111). Classification: YES, combined feed*tightness beats either alone (AUC 0.700 vs 0.618/0.576).
Main support: Richness x WL-mass jointly classify large-scale environment (structured vs unstructured) better than either alone (AUC 0.700 vs 0.618 for richness, 0.576 for mass).
Main contradiction: MWLc is r=0.978 correlated with richness alone (R2=0.973); it is a calibrated forecast, not an independent lensing measurement, so 'tightness' is not cleanly separable from 'feed' in this dataset.
Main caveat: No raw per-cluster shear/convergence catalog was available publicly within the search budget; MWLc is a scaling-relation forecast. Photo-z scatter smears the 3D neighbor-density estimate.
